# Live and Let's Fly

> > A travel blog focused on airline industry news, frequent flyer programs, and aviation policy with deep coverage of United Airlines, Star Alliance partners, and passenger rights.

Live and Let's Fly provides commentary on airline operations, loyalty programs, regulatory issues, and travel experiences. The site offers practical travel tips alongside analysis of industry developments, particularly around United Airlines, Southwest Airlines, and major aviation policy debates.

## Key Topics

- United Airlines
- Star Alliance
- Award Availability
- StarNet Blocking
- Frequent Flyer Programs
- Airline Regulation
- DOT Tarmac Delay Rules
- Customer Service
- Southwest Airlines
- United Express
- Aviation Policy
- Travel Tips
- Airport Operations
- Loyalty Programs
- Passenger Rights

## United Airlines & Star Alliance

- [Partner Blackout Dates on United Airlines](https://liveandletsfly.com/partner-blackout-dates-on-united-airlines): Star Alliance partner award blackout dates and StarNet blocking on United
- [Circumventing United Airline's StarNet Blocking](https://liveandletsfly.com/circumventing-united-airlines-starnet-blocking): Workarounds for United StarNet award availability blocking on partners
- [UA's Smisek Discusses Channel 9, 747 IFE, and the Future of Three-Cabin First Class](https://liveandletsfly.com/uas-smisek-discusses-channel-9-747-ife-and-the-future-of-three-cabin-first-class): United CEO Smisek on Channel 9 ATC, 747 upgrades, and first class future
- [United Express Coming to DCA](https://liveandletsfly.com/united-express-coming-to-dca): United Express E-170 regional service expansion to Reagan National Airport
- [More Details Emerge About the Diversion to Omaha on United 142](https://liveandletsfly.com/more-details-emerge-about-the-diversion-to-omaha-on-united-142): Unruly passenger causes United 142 emergency diversion to Omaha
- [After Blogging About Bumps, I Get Bumped Off a United Express Flight](https://liveandletsfly.com/after-blogging-about-bumps-i-get-bumped-off-a-united-express-flight): Author's personal experience being bumped from United Express at Dulles
